limitations: Prices and page availability are a 2026-10-31 research snapshot. Recheck the live product page, quantity, shipping, tax and lead time immediately before any owner-approved order.
Maximum-efficiency points and no-load values are manufacturer data, not measured loaded robot performance. Stall values are theoretical extrapolations and must not be used as continuous ratings.
Passing the arithmetic speed, torque and encoder screens does not select a final motor or satisfy E02/E03.
The 80 mm wheel mule is an explicit geometry variant. Its calculated requirements differ from the existing 3-inch baseline and its silicone-tire traction must be measured.
The STEP files are shared ratio-family models, not proof of exact vendor dimensions for every unit. Check received hardware and current drawings before fabrication.
Driver, battery, charger, controller, fuse, wire gauge and mechanism actuator remain unselected. No complete robot or production harness is released.
FAU access is an owner-provided planning assumption; supervision, battery, charging, training, storage, test-space and fee details are not verified.
